data.gender_notes: Amadore is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'amare' meaning 'to love'. The name Amadore is a derivative of the name Amadeus, which was a common name in the Middle Ages. It was given to boys born into noble families and was considered a sign of love and affection. The name Amadore carries the meaning “Beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Amadore usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents love and devotion, making it a fitting name for a child with a loving and caring nature.

in_hebrew.name: עמדור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עמדור (Amadore) - שמה שלא ידועה, אך היא יכולה להיות קשורה למלה Amor, שמשמעה 'אהבה', 'חסד', ו'תמיכה'. בהקשר נוצרי, עמדור עשויה לסמל את חסד האל, את תמיכתו, ואת שמחתו העצומה. ככל הנראה, שם זה התפתח מהמילה העברית 'עמד', שפירושה 'לעמוד, לתמוך', ומהלטינית 'dor', שפירושה 'רצון, חסד'.

in_greek.name: Αμαδωρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Αμαδωρ (Amadōr) - ονομασία που δεν είναι γνωστή, αλλά μπορεί να σχετίζεται με τη λέξη Amor, η οποία σημαίνει 'ἀγάπη', 'ἔλεος' και 'στήριξη'. Στον χριστιανισμό, ο Αμαδωρ μπορεί να συμβολίζει τη φιλανθρωπία του Θεού, τη στήριξή του και την υπερβολική χαρά. Πιθανότατα, το όνομα αυτό προέκυψε από τη λέξη αμάντα (amantos), η οποία σημαίνει 'τήρηση, υποστήριξη' και το λατινικό dor, που σημαίνει 'θέλημα, φιλανθρωπία'.

in_latin.name: Amadore
in_latin.long_meaning: Amadore - nomen quod incertum est, sed potest fieri ex vocabulo Amor, quod significat 'amor', 'caritas', et 'auxilium'. In contextu Christiano, Amadore potest significare beneficentiam Dei, auxilium ejus, et gaudeo ejus immoderatum. Probabiliter, nomen hoc ortum est ex vocabulo amantem, quod significat 'amare, auxiliari' et dor, quod significat 'voluntas, caritas'.

in_english.name: Amadore
in_english.long_meaning: Amadore - a name that is not well-known, but it may be related to the word Amor, which means 'love', 'charity', and 'aid'. In the Christian context, Amadore can symbolize God's charity, aid, and immoderate joy. It is likely that this name originated from the Hebrew word 'amod', which means 'to stand, to support', and the Latin word 'dor', which means 'will, charity'. This name is a combination of the Latin words 'amor' and 'dor', conveying the concept of loving and supporting others.

pronunciation.biblical: Hebrew pronunciation: Ah-mah-DOOR, Greek pronunciation: Ah-mah-DOHR

Naming a child Amadore was a way for parents to bestow upon them the blessings of love, joy, and good fortune.
